patterns.note: The homepage initially presents a full-screen blank canvas with a large, centered text element, which then transitions to a full-bleed image and a persistent left-aligned project navigation sidebar upon scroll.
Project detail pages are dominated by full-bleed photography, with minimal text descriptions placed either below the hero image or alongside smaller image galleries, emphasizing visual content.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for main content and project titles, contrasted by very small, light-weight sans-serif text used for navigation, body copy, and metadata.
The site employs a stark monochromatic color scheme of white, black, and various shades of grey, with vibrant color introduced almost exclusively through large-scale, high-quality photography.

Upon initial scroll, the large, centered homepage hero text smoothly scrolls upwards and out of view, revealing a full-width image and a fixed-position left sidebar containing a scrollable list of projects.

A persistent, scrollable left sidebar serves as the primary project navigation on the homepage, displaying project titles with numerical indicators, allowing users to browse the portfolio without leaving the main view.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a scroll-triggered content reveal system where an initial full-screen text hero animates off-screen to unveil a visual hero and a fixed-position, scrollable project navigation sidebar, creating a dynamic entry experience.

Navigation and supplementary text elements are rendered in a very small, light-weight sans-serif font to maintain a clean, minimal aesthetic, ensuring they support rather than compete with the large, bold display typography and imagery.

Visual content, primarily high-resolution architectural photography, is presented in full-bleed sections across the entire page width to maximize impact and create an immersive, gallery-like experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic type scale features oversized, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~5x body text) paired with very small, light-weight sans-serif text for navigation and detailed information, creating a strong visual contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy on the initial homepage hero, transitioning to a balanced density on project detail pages with ample whitespace around images and text blocks, and a denser layout within the project list sidebar.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its initial 'blank canvas' homepage that dramatically transforms on scroll, revealing a persistent, scrollable project list sidebar alongside immersive, full-bleed architectural photography. This creates a highly editorial and visually driven experience, prioritizing impact over immediate information density.
